source_page_metadata.description: Explore the Shit strain from Mr. Nice Seedbank, an Afghani-dominant Skunk #1 hybrid with pungent flavor, relaxing effects, fast flowering, and heavy yields.

article_blocks.text: Strain Type: Indica-dominant hybrid
Genetics: Skunk #1 ( Afghani -dominant) × Skunk #1
Breeder: Mr. Nice Seedbank
THC Content: 13.75–17.25%
CBD Content: 0.48–0.75%
Terpene Profile: myrcene , caryophyllene , limonene
Primary Flavors: Pungent Skunk, earth, sweet herbs
Flowering Time (Indoor): 40–50 days
Outdoor Harvest Time: Late September to early October
Indoor Yield: 550–650 g/m²
Outdoor Yield: More than 500 g per plant
Grow Difficulty: Easy

Few marijuana strains wear their lack of sophistication as proudly as Shit . The intentionally crude name hides a serious piece of cannabis breeding history: Mr. Nice Seedbank’s preservation-minded interpretation of old-school Skunk genetics, developed around Afghani-dominant expressions rather than the increasingly sweet Skunk selections that became common in Europe. The breeder classifies the family as Skunk #1 (Afghani-dominant) × Skunk #1 and describes it as a proven line dating back to the 1980s.

Unlike cultivars designed around exotic dessert flavors, Shit is meant to smell unmistakably like weed—pungent, musky, earthy, and intensely Skunk-driven. It also retains the practical qualities that helped make Skunk genetics foundational to modern cannabis breeding: fast flowering, heavy yields, exceptional hardiness, and adaptability to indoor rooms, greenhouses, and outdoor gardens. Mr. Nice lists approximately 40–50 days of indoor flowering and potential yields of 550–650 grams per square meter, making the strain as useful horticulturally as it is historically significant.
Genetics and Lineage

Mr. Nice Seedbank formally lists Shit’s family breeding as Skunk #1 (Afghani-dominant) × Skunk #1. The breeder also describes the cultivar more generally as an original Skunk/Afghani , terminology that has occasionally led secondary sources to simplify the pedigree into Skunk crossed directly with a separate Afghani landrace . The more precise breeder table makes the distinction clearer: an Afghani-dominant Skunk #1 selection was crossed back into Skunk #1, concentrating the heavier side of the old Skunk family while retaining the vigor and hybrid character that made Skunk #1 famous.

The deeper Skunk #1 family traditionally brings together Afghan, Colombian , and Mexican cannabis ancestry. Genealogical records for the Mr. Nice line trace the Skunk foundation through Afghan × Colombian material crossed with Mexican genetics, creating the combination of broad-leaf strength and sativa-influenced vigor that helped Skunk #1 become such an influential breeding plant. Shit emphasizes the Afghani end of that population, which helps explain its shorter flowering time, pronounced physical relaxation, heavy production, and stronger earthy-pungent qualities.

Nevil Schoenmakers and Shantibaba are credited by Mr. Nice as the breeders behind the line. The company places Shit in its “Naturals – Old School Genetics” category and describes it as a true-breeding variety preserved from the early seed-bank era. For strain historians, that is arguably its greatest importance: this cultivar is not an attempt to reinvent Skunk with modern Cookies, Gelato, or fruit genetics. It exists to preserve an older, Afghani-heavy interpretation of one of marijuana breeding’s foundational families.
Effects and Experience

The high tends to feel grounded without becoming instantly overwhelming. A modest amount may produce an initial rise in mood and a comfortable mental looseness, allowing conversation, music, or casual activity to remain enjoyable. Compared with a sharp tropical sativa, thoughts generally move at a calmer pace. The Skunk side can preserve sociability and some mental brightness, while the Afghani-dominant influence increasingly pulls the experience toward physical relaxation.

As time passes, the body becomes more involved. Shoulders loosen, muscular tension becomes less noticeable, and sitting down starts to feel more appealing. The effect is better characterized as relaxed and stoned than aggressively narcotic, especially at moderate doses. Commercial descriptions based on the original genetics commonly place it between uplifting and relaxing rather than at either extreme. Larger servings naturally reveal the heavier side, creating greater lethargy, appetite stimulation, and a more traditional evening-style Skunk stone.

Current Mr. Nice material gives THC at approximately 13.75–17.25% and CBD at roughly 0.48–0.75%. Those numbers are modest beside today’s 25–30% THC cultivars, but potency percentages alone do not describe the entire experience. Older Skunk genetics can produce a robust, sustained intoxication even without extreme laboratory numbers, while phenotype, harvest maturity, cultivation environment, and individual tolerance can substantially alter how strong a particular batch feels.
Medical Benefits

The physical relaxation associated with Shit may appeal to medical cannabis consumers who prefer uncomplicated, traditional indica-leaning weed. Some people choose cultivars with this type of effect profile when looking for temporary relief from muscular tension, everyday stress, appetite loss, or difficulty becoming comfortable at the end of the day. The mental component can remain sufficiently clear at lower doses that relaxation does not automatically mean immediate sleep.

Its modest but measurable CBD content is also notable compared with many modern THC-dominant strains, although the breeder’s published range of roughly 0.48–0.75% is still far below what would qualify as a CBD-rich cultivar. Any therapeutic experience is therefore likely to remain strongly THC-driven.

Shit itself has not been established through controlled clinical research as a treatment for pain, insomnia, anxiety, or another medical condition. Cannabis effects vary substantially between individuals, and THC can cause dizziness, anxiety, dry mouth, impaired coordination, or excessive sedation. Medical consumers should use laboratory information from the actual flower rather than assuming every plant from the strain will reproduce the breeder’s cannabinoid averages.
Flavor Profile and Aroma

Subtlety is not the goal. Mr. Nice describes Shit as distinctly skunky and pungent, which is exactly what enthusiasts of older Skunk cannabis generally seek. The aroma can begin with musky earth and unmistakable marijuana funk before developing sweeter herbal notes, spice, and occasional fruit or citrus depending on phenotype. Certain plants lean darker and more Afghani, while others reveal a somewhat sweeter Skunk expression.

Once the flower is broken apart, the pungency becomes considerably stronger. Earth, musk, dried herbs, and an acrid Skunk quality dominate, sometimes accompanied by onion-like, spicy, or mildly sweet characteristics. Grower reports from preserved Mr. Nice populations also document occasional tropical, citrus, fruity, and especially powerful Skunk expressions, illustrating the aromatic range still present within the old line.

No official terpene panel has been published for the cultivar, so presenting myrcene, caryophyllene, or another terpene as universally dominant would be misleading. Myrcene would fit the earthy-musky side, caryophyllene the spice, and limonene or pinene could contribute occasional brighter herbal and citrus characteristics. The precise composition depends on the individual plant and growing environment.
Growing Information

Cultivation is one of Shit’s strongest advantages. Mr. Nice specifically recommends the strain for everyone from inexperienced growers to advanced cultivators and describes it as extremely hardy. It can be grown organically or hydroponically and performs indoors, outdoors, and in greenhouses. Greenhouse production receives special praise from the breeder because the combination of rapid flowering and robust structure allows the plant to take advantage of natural sunlight without requiring an exceptionally long season.

Indoor flowering takes only 40–50 days, or approximately seven weeks. That speed is impressive for a hybrid with genuine old Skunk ancestry and helps explain why the genetics historically appealed to production growers. The breeder lists approximately 550–650 g/m² indoors, while greenhouse and outdoor plants can exceed 500 grams each under favorable conditions. These are breeder potential figures rather than guaranteed harvests, but they demonstrate the line’s reputation for combining quick turnover with substantial weight.

Plant structure varies somewhat according to how strongly the Afghani-dominant parent expresses itself. Shorter specimens may develop broad foliage, sturdy branches, and dense central flowers, while more Skunk-oriented individuals can stretch farther and produce longer branching. Early topping or low-stress training can create a broader canopy indoors, although the cultivar’s naturally productive structure does not demand complicated techniques. Maintaining airflow becomes increasingly important as flowers gain density.

Outdoor growers gain another advantage from the early finish. Mr. Nice places Northern Hemisphere maturity from late September into early October, with Southern Hemisphere crops completing around late March to early April. That timing can allow growers in temperate climates to harvest before persistent autumn rain becomes severe. Combined with its hardiness and short flowering cycle, this makes Shit one of the more practical old-school strains for growers who want authentic Skunk genetics without a demanding cultivation schedule.
FAQ
What are the genetics of the Shit strain?
Mr. Nice Seedbank lists Shit as Skunk #1 (Afghani-dominant) × Skunk #1. The breeder also describes it more broadly as an original Skunk/Afghani line.
Who bred the Shit strain?
The cultivar comes from Mr. Nice Seedbank and is credited to Nevil Schoenmakers and Shantibaba. Mr. Nice places it among its old-school “Naturals” genetic collection.
Is Shit indica or sativa?
Current Mr. Nice information classifies it as an indica-dominant hybrid. Its Afghani-heavy Skunk ancestry contributes fast flowering, substantial yields, and a progressively relaxing physical effect.
How long does Shit take to flower?
Indoor flowering generally requires approximately 40–50 days, or close to seven weeks. Outdoors, plants typically finish from late September to early October in the Northern Hemisphere.
What does the Shit strain smell and taste like?

Pungent Skunk is the defining characteristic. Earth, musk, herbs, spice, and occasional sweet or fruity notes can accompany the classic Skunk funk, with significant variation possible between seed-grown phenotypes. Mr. Nice specifically identifies the aroma and flavor as skunky and pungent.
Final Thoughts on Shit

The name may sound like a joke, but the genetics are serious. Shit represents Mr. Nice Seedbank’s attempt to maintain an Afghani-dominant branch of classic Skunk #1 rather than transforming it into a sweeter modern hybrid. That gives the strain genuine historical value for growers interested in the foundational cannabis lines that helped shape European and North American marijuana breeding.

Its practical characteristics are equally convincing. Roughly seven weeks of flowering, breeder-listed indoor yields reaching 550–650 g/m², more than 500 grams per outdoor plant under favorable conditions, and late-September to early-October maturity make the cultivar efficient without relying on autoflowering genetics. The plant is also hardy enough that Mr. Nice explicitly recommends it to beginners.

For consumers, Shit offers the kind of profile its name promises: pungent, musky, earthy, unapologetically Skunk-heavy weed followed by a comfortable transition from mild mental uplift into physical relaxation. In a market increasingly dominated by dessert, candy, and fuel hybrids, its greatest strength may be that it does not try to taste modern. Shit remains an old-school Skunk cultivar built around vigor, yield, short flowering, and the unmistakable aroma that made the Skunk family famous in the first place.
